description: This Java class defines the CreateOrderFromCartFlow service, responsible for orchestrating the checkout process from a shopping cart. It includes methods for validating cart data, reserving inventory, calculating totals, applying discounts, calculating taxes, and creating an order. It interacts with multiple external service clients like cart, order, pricing, tax, promotions, and inventory services to perform its functions.

classes.name: CreateOrderFromCartFlow
classes.description: A service class orchestrating the checkout flow from cart validation, inventory reservation, calculation of totals, applying discounts and taxes, and order creation in a phased process.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main method to perform the checkout process from cart validation, reservation, calculations, and order creation. Returns a CheckoutResult with order details.

methods.name: validateCartMatchesRequest
methods.description: Validates that the cart data matches provided request parameters to prevent mismatched checkouts.

methods.name: reserveInventoryOrThrow
methods.description: Reserves inventory for each cart item; throws exception if reservation fails.

methods.name: mapCartToCreateOrder
methods.description: Maps cart data to create an order request object.

methods.name: calculateSubtotal
methods.description: Calculates the subtotal of cart items using pricing service.

methods.name: resolveUnitPriceOrZero
methods.description: Resolves unit price for a SKU from pricing service; returns zero if not available.

methods.name: normalizeStoreCode
methods.description: Normalizes the store code string to a standard form.

methods.name: stableStoreIdLong
methods.description: Creates a stable long identifier from UUID for store ID to satisfy external API contracts.
